observations: body L1-L43: every line of the quotation of al-Khāzinī opens with a guillemet, as printed; the quotation runs on from p. 279, L46.

body L10-L16: if the parallax grows in proportion to the time from the true conjunction, the parallax sought, P = p₁ + (p₂ − p₁)·P/p₁ with p₁ and p₂ the first and the second parallax, is p₁²/(2p₁ − p₂) = p₁ + (p₂ − p₁) + (p₂ − p₁)²/p₁ + …, and the rule gives it to the second order. When the second parallax is the greater, the difference increased by its square over the smaller parallax is added to the first parallax, as printed. When the first is the greater, the parallax sought lies between the two, p₁ − d + d²/p₁ − … with d = p₁ − p₂, and the difference lessened by that quantity must be taken from the first parallax: «addita» (L16) holds for the first case only.
body L12: the proportion is centred, with the colons and the equals sign (9.5 pt) as printed.
body L14: the dashes of «al–ǵuz’» and «al–maǵhūl» measure 4.4 and 5.2 pt.
body L19, L23, L32, L42: the dashes measure 10.2, 9.7, 10.1 and 10.1 pt.
body L23-L24, L42: «Thābit», «Indi» and «al–Battānī» (long dash, 5.3 pt) are letter-spaced.
body L26: a speck stands after «Lunae», like a full stop; the sentence runs on.

notes_left L1: «Suter» is letter-spaced; «34-38» has a hyphen (3.2 pt). The year 288 of the Hiǵrah ran from 26 December 900 to 15 December 901 (Julian, by the tabular calendar), almost all of it in 901.
notes_right L1: «al-Ma’mūn» has a hyphen (3.4 pt). The print sets no rule between the two columns of the notes.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
